note: Where each bank publishes savings and FD rates. Rates are LIVE data — they belong in the service with a rate history, never in this repo. What the repo takes from these pages is the account's identity and terms: type, minimum balance, deposit insurance, premature-withdrawal penalty. debit_cards points at each bank's debit card page; fees there must be cross-checked against the schedule of charges before a record is published.
domains: Indian banks publish on the RBI-mandated .bank.in domain. Every URL here was fetched through lib/polite.py and kept only when it answered 200 at the URL asked for — a bank's site will answer 200 for a path it no longer serves by redirecting to its home page or sitemap, so a redirect is treated as 'page not found' rather than a hit. The page was also required to mention what it claims to be about, which is what separates a real fixed-deposit page from a landing page that merely links to one.

banks.unreachable: www.yes.bank.in answers 200 at the root and robots.txt allows it, but the home page carries no link matching savings, deposit, debit-card, interest-rate or charges — the navigation is script-built. A deeper entry point has to be found before this bank can be read.

equitas.bank.in answered HTTP 503 for robots.txt (retried 3x), so polite.py fails closed and no page was fetched. 503 is a server error, not a rule — worth re-checking, and it may simply pass on another day.

canara.bank.in did not serve robots.txt at all (URLError, retried 3x by polite.py), so every path is treated as disallowed and nothing here was fetched. A refusal to state rules is not permission. Scoped to this host on 2026-09-09; the bank is not otherwise known to be uncrawlable.

www.federal.bank.in serves robots.txt and allows the root, but every request lands on validate.perfdrive.com — a bot-detection interstitial. The bank is not refusing by rule; an automated client is being challenged. Nothing was read, and no header trick should be used to get past it.

www.indiapost.gov.in publishes no robots.txt (HTTP 404) and /banking-services/savings answers 200, but the served markup is a 2,294-character navigation shell carrying zero occurrences of 'savings account', 'recurring deposit', 'time deposit' or 'interest' — the scheme table is drawn by JavaScript. Needs a browser-saved page, like samsung.com in the phones domain.
banks.note: Government backed, not DICGC. institution_type is 'Post Office' in the schema's vocabulary.

banks.unreachable: www.bajajfinserv.in answers 200 at the root with no robots restriction, but exposes no deposit or charges link in the served markup, and the old /fixed-deposit-interest-rate path now 404s. NBFC deposits are NOT DICGC insured — the single most material fact about them — so this one is worth chasing.
banks.note: NBFC deposits are NOT DICGC insured — the single most material fact about them
